title: The ruler
logline: The steel ruler he ruled the Sunday grids with for sixteen years, on the drafting table, and beside it the blue pencil, and neither in a hand. A week before the last ruled sheet. The page draws the tools as objects because they're about to be.

panels.composition: A steel ruler and a blue pencil lying parallel on a drafting table under the lamp, a blank sheet beside them with no lines on it, a mug ring on the table's wood.
